CustomField.description: The amount tax was calculated on: the order subtotal after any discount, plus shipping. Stored rather than derived because the rate, the discount and the shipping rule can all change afterwards, and a tax figure has to stay explainable years later - this is the number the rate was actually applied to on the day.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: What the tax was calculated on: subtotal after discount, plus shipping.
CustomField.label: Tax Base
